correctness.rationale: The unilateral right shift S on ℓ² has S*S=I and non-surjective range, and S* is a norm-one LEFT inverse. For ONB and U1=U2=S, δ=0<1 yet <e1,Sej>=0 all j: not even a frame. Repair: U_k V=I implies ||U_k*f||≥||V||^{-1}||f||; the baseline woven analysis has lower √A/||V||. By Bessel bound the error direct-sum norm ≤√(B(m−1))δ||f||. Reverse triangle gives positive uniform lower frame bound and triangle gives B(||U_k||+√(m−1)δ)² upper. All partitions covered. Does not claim threshold necessary.
